note: The front and back legs come from different senders through different contracts (0x78a5… and 0x860b…). Each is a self-contained arbitrage: it buys SOCKS with ETH on the 0x22d8… exchange and sells it the same leg into V2 pool 0x0dac…, nets about +0.0539 ETH and +0.2294 ETH before gas respectively, and holds no SOCKS between the legs. No single actor opens a position before the victim's WETH→SOCKS buy on 0x0dac… and closes it after, so there is no bracket and no actor P&L to compute.
